## Per-clause verdicts 1/5 — access-security (6 items)

**4 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** The two PARTIALs come only from legs the items themselves record as unreachable (`fixtures.knownGaps`).

### Environment

- **Boot 1 (stock, `single`)**: `OS_PORT=47601 setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 47601 -d file:(scratch)/main.db`. Started 2026-10-22T12:46:30Z, banner `Tenancy: single`, stopped through its process group at 12:57Z.
- **Boot 2/3 (walled, `isolated`)**: a scratch full copy of examples/app-showcase; every dependency a `link:` to its workspace or store path, plus `@objectstack/organizations` → `link:packages/plugins/organizations`, installed with `pnpm install --ignore-workspace --offline` inside the scratch dir only. Booted with `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only … objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 47602`. Started 12:58:06Z. Banner `Tenancy: isolated`, `Organizations` mounted, nothing DEGRADED; `/auth/config` reported `tenancyPosture:"isolated", multiOrgEnabled:true, degradedTenancy:false`. Restarted once around a fixture write (below); stopped at 13:00:37Z.
- Personas minted by invite-then-sign-up (stock) or admin create-user + change-password (walled); each identity checked with `GET /auth/get-session` before use (auth-state-leak trap).
- **Pin layer.** The dogfood pins boot `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack`, the full `serve` composition answered through Hono `app.request` in-process (`packages/verify/src/harness.ts`): the **HTTP** layer without a socket. The objectql pins are the **engine** layer. The rest and runtime walled pins are **plugin/domain unit** layer, which is why the walled item's live legs were also driven.

Pin results (all `--maxWorkers=1`):
- dogfood, 13 files (all 6 items): `Test Files 13 passed (13) · Tests 226 passed (226)`.
- re-run of the 3 wall-* dogfood files, verbose: `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 63 passed (63)` (wall-environment-metadata-refusal 23, wall-package-doors-refusal 23, wall-catalog-refusal 17).
- objectql `engine-insert-static-readonly-strip.test.ts` + `engine-readonly-strip-caller-values.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 55 passed (55)`; the named cases "isSystem seeds the readonly column — the exemption the ruling names" and "an isSystem caller is untouched by any of this" both ✓.
- rest `meta-migrate-stored-walled-refusal.test.ts`: `Tests 6 passed (6)`.
- runtime `packages-walled-write-refusal` + `automation-walled-definition-write` + `meta-walled-catalog-refusal`: `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 61 passed (61)`.
- `objectstack verify --rls` (12:53:20–12:53:54Z, exit 0): CRUD tail `── 15 verified, 0 gaps, 0 FAILED, 1 needs-fixture, 8 skipped (0 mismatches)`; per-persona line (probe persona, unit = objects) `── 21 PROVEN (21 consistent, 0 HOLES) · 3 NOT PROVEN (0 member-visible, 0 probe-blocked, 3 skipped)`; `10 of 10 declared position(s) probed`; total line (unit = object × persona) `══ all personas: 38 PROVEN (38 consistent, 0 HOLES) · 226 NOT PROVEN (131 member-visible, 62 probe-blocked, 33 skipped)`.
